metadata.description: An extra pair of hands for your store.

plugins.name: storehand
plugins.description: Open-source skills that turn Claude into your daily Shopify operator. Today: store setup and a daily briefing (orders, payment problems, cancellations, stock alerts). On the way: health checks, listing writing, price watching, SEO audits and weekly reports. Runs through the official Shopify CLI. Read-only by default. Sends no telemetry.
